title: Title issues complicate £1.5m Cambridge bridging deal
summary:
Recognise Bank has provided £1.5 million in bridging finance to enable a property investor to acquire a mixed-use property in Cambridge at auction. The transaction was complicated by historic title issues that could not be resolved through standard indemnity insurance.

title: Microsoft outage disrupts property completions across UK
summary:
Estate agencies across the UK faced operational challenges on Friday as a major Microsoft IT outage disrupted property transactions. The widespread failure of Microsoft services forced agencies to revert to traditional communication methods to complete sales and lettings.

title: Microsoft outage highlights conveyancing productivity challenges
summary:
A recent Microsoft outage that disrupted email services revealed an unexpected consequence for property conveyancing: many legal professionals reported increased productivity during the downtime. The November 2026 incident highlighted challenges around constant communication demands and their impact on substantive legal work.

title: Research finds 24% of proptech firms fail to explain services
summary:
Nearly a quarter of proptech companies fail to clearly communicate what they do on their website homepages, according to new research that highlights a significant communication gap in the sector. Consultancy Parapet Intelligence analysed 500 proptech websites and found that 119 companies – representing 23.8% of the sample – did not explain their services in the initial content visible to visitors.

title: Andrews Property Group staff appointed to industry bodies
summary:
Three employees from Andrews Property Group have been appointed to regional representative positions with industry organisations. Shannon Smith and Jenna Bugler take on ARLA Propertymark roles, while Jordane Alsultan becomes Regional Champion for Women in Estate Agency in Essex.

title: Updated guidance clarifies damages and cleaning fees rules
summary:
The Government has issued updated guidance on the Tenant Fees Act, clarifying when landlords and letting agents can claim damages during a tenancy and reiterating the prohibition on mandatory cleaning fees. The revised guidance warns against making claims for damages that aim to deter or punish tenants for contract breaches.

title: UK asking prices fall 1.8% as mortgage costs squeeze buyers
summary:
Average asking prices for UK properties fell by 1.8% in November to £364,270, exceeding the typical seasonal decline as sellers adjust to buyer affordability constraints. Annual asking prices now stand 0.2% below November 2025 levels, with regional variations showing Scotland leading growth at 3.8% whilst the South West declined 1.1%.

title: Bank of England signals further rate rises into 2027
summary:
The Bank of England is expected to raise interest rates in December and potentially into early 2027, according to chief economist Huw Pill. The signalled increases are expected to result in higher mortgage payments for approximately 2.3 million homeowners who will need to refinance their loans next year.

title: Subsidence claims surge following record hot summers
summary:
Major UK insurers have reported significant increases in subsidence claims following two consecutive record hot summers. Aviva, Hastings Direct and Axa have all confirmed rises, with average claim values reaching £20,000 and total payouts hitting £72m in the second quarter of 2024.

title: Hampshire Trust Bank completes £1.15m Marylebone bridge in six days
summary:
Hampshire Trust Bank has completed £1.15 million of bridging finance for an overseas borrower against a property in Marylebone, London, completing the transaction in six days from formal offer to drawdown. The 12-month facility will provide capital for two planned auction purchases.
